notes.title: Update 0.3.1 is out
notes.content:
The first patch is out for the festival demo!

- Added a display of the answers you give to the history screen
- Added animation of tab bar appearing
- Added Brezg Studio logo to appear at startup
- Battle phrases stay on screen a little longer
- Fixed tab bar behavior when changing resolution
- Fixed the size of the buttons on the battle screen when playing with a low resolution
- Improved the disappearing animation of the battle screen

True Magician demo will be available until October 7.

notes.title: The demo is available now
notes.content:
Hello again!
 
[b]True Magician[/b] is taking part in the Steam Fall Festival!

That means that from October 1 to 7 an updated demo version of the game will be [b]available for download[/b]. It contains the first two chapters - about 20% of the planned volume. In this build you will see:
 
Significantly increased content. Particular attention was paid to alternative ways of passing
A new version of the interface and other graphical improvements
A full inventory system
Original soundtrack
 
...and much more.

However, there is still a lot of work ahead. We will be glad to receive any feedback, bug reports and constructive criticism. Only thanks to the players True Magician will become the game we dream about.

See you soon!

notes.title: True Magician Announcement!
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! 

We're the [i]Dark Citadel[/i] team, and we have some big news. Previously we worked on [b]For the People[/b] official simulator, the debut of [i]Brezg Studio[/i], and now we're ready to use the experience we gained in the first project of our division.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042292/fac6a97ff67459a4ed56c88347d119405c6c1e6c.png[/img]

So, meet [b]True Magician[/b]. It's a non-linear RPG-like [i]Sorcery![/i] and [i]Choice of Magics[/i] narrative game about a young apprentice wizard named Aidan. Here ancient secrets intertwine with the intrigues of the king's court, danger lurks where you least expect it, and magic grants its adherents incredible abilities - or destroys them irrevocably.

Together with Aidan you will go through many trials, discover his true potential, master the forbidden magic of the Void - and become a true wizard! Of course, if his witchcraft doesn't attract the attention of Those whose voices come from the other world...

True Magician[/b] is an interactive adventure in the best traditions of text quests: the story branches depending on the choice of the player, the world reacts to his decisions, and important characters can become enemies, friends or even more than friends... We added elements from RPG to the classic formula - combat system, inventory and development of magical skills. In addition, specially for the game was drawn art - a relatively uncommon guest in text games.

In the future we will reveal a lot of interesting things about our new project and its inhabitants. There will definitely be a demo-version to give you a closer look at the game - the exact date will be announced later. In the meantime, add [b]True Magician[/b] to your Steam wishlist, so you won't miss anything!
